_comment: Ordered subsets of the design problems with a declared time budget — the answer to 'I have 45 minutes, what do I drill?'. Mirrors data/paths.json in the main app rather than inventing a parallel concept. Progress is keyed by UNIT id, never by plan, so switching or abandoning a plan can never reset mastery: a plan is a route through the content, not a copy of it. `units: "*"` means every unit in manifest (parts[]) order. `mode:"crux"` runs only each unit's crux:true questions. Company plans are NOT listed here — they are generated from the `company` tag (see companyPlans below), so tagging one problem grows every relevant loop set for free. Validator: tools/validate-system-design.js checks every referenced unit exists, that crux plans reference only units that actually have crux questions, and that budget/title/blurb are present.

companyPlans._comment: Any company tagged on >= minUnits problems renders an implicit plan. budgetPerUnit is minutes, used to derive the displayed budget.

plans.title: Night Before
plans.blurb: Eight highest-frequency problems, crux questions only. The panic pass.

plans.title: One Week Core
plans.blurb: One problem per mechanism family, then the highest-yield second pick. Broadest coverage per hour spent.

plans.title: AI Infra Sprint
plans.blurb: The category the classic canon predates — inference serving, retrieval, feature stores, moderation. For AI-company loops.

plans.title: Build the Box
plans.blurb: Design the infrastructure itself rather than a product on top of it — cache, queue, scheduler, KV store, rate limiter, webhooks.

plans.title: Data & Streaming
plans.blurb: Event pipelines end to end: the log, the aggregation on top of it, and the observability platform that watches both.

plans.title: The Full Canon
plans.blurb: All 32 problems in curriculum order, family by family.
